narrative: 这一口，就是剪辑点。面条、初次约会、一个吃得太香的反派：摄影机猛地对准食物碰到嘴的瞬间。
是滑稽还是诱人，取决于灯光有多友善。一个宽景的餐桌主镜头并不需要这个技巧。
如果你还能看到整间餐厅，就说明没有真正猛推到位。如果最后一帧里没有食物，那你拍的其实是推入嘴部（Mouth In）。
how: 设计一个不到一秒的急速变焦，结束在这一口上。稳住画面。
不要用推轨。用蒸汽、油光或滴落来证明食物的存在。
脸部可以只露出一部分。提示词：Eating zoom on [Subject], a crash into the bite, chopsticks or spoon as the last foreground, appetite as a punch-in.
when: 当这一口本身就是事件时使用。不要把它用在空盘子或整张餐桌上。
vs: 急推变焦（Crash Zoom In）可以落在任何东西上；而这个技巧必须落在食物碰到嘴的瞬间。推入嘴部（Mouth In）是进入口腔本身，不需要有菜肴出现。
微距（Macro）是一种画面尺度，通常是固定的，而不是一次猛推。
examples_film: 《蒲公英》（Tampopo）把这一口本身当作整场戏来处理。ASMR吃播借用了这种语法，并把它变得更柔和。
定格画面应该能让人一眼说出这是什么菜。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是推入嘴部，或者餐厅的宽景。破绽在于：最后一帧里没有食物，或者整个餐厅依然清晰可见。
解决办法：急速推向这一口，用餐具作为最后的前景，稳住画面。

faq.q: 电影中的吃播急推（Eating Zoom）是什么？
faq.a: 吃播急推是对准这一口的急推变焦，用食物或餐具作为最后的前景。食欲本身就是这次猛推的落点。

faq.q: 吃播急推（Eating Zoom）与推入嘴部（Mouth In）的区别
faq.a: 推入嘴部把口腔当作一片地景来进入。吃播急推则是纯光学的、以食物为先：这次猛推结束在这一口上。

faq.q: 什么时候该用吃播急推（Eating Zoom）？
faq.a: 当这一口本身就是事件时使用。不要把它用作整张餐桌的覆盖镜头。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写吃播急推（Eating Zoom）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明急速推向食物碰到嘴的瞬间。示例：Eating zoom on [Subject], a crash into the bite, chopsticks or spoon as the last foreground.

narrative: The bite is the cut. Noodles, a first date, a villain who eats too well: the camera snaps to food meeting mouth.
Comic or sensual depends on how kind the light is. A wide dinner master does not want this.
If you still see the restaurant, you did not crash. If there is no food in the last frame, you shot a mouth-in.
how: Write a snap zoom, under a second, ending on the bite. Hold.
Do not dolly. Show steam, gloss, or dripping as proof of the food.
The face can be partial. Prompt: Eating zoom on [Subject], a crash into the bite, chopsticks or spoon as the last foreground, appetite as a punch-in.
when: Use it when the bite is the event. Do not use it on an empty plate or a whole table.
vs: A Crash Zoom In can land on anything; this one must land on food meeting mouth. Mouth In travels into the orifice without requiring the dish.
Macro is a scale, often locked, not a crash.
examples_film: Tampopo treats the bite as the scene. ASMR tables stole the grammar and made it soft.
The still should let you name the dish.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a mouth-in or a restaurant wide. The tell: no food in the last frame, or the whole dining room still visible.
The fix: snap into the bite, utensil as last foreground, hold.

faq.q: What is Eating Zoom in film?
faq.a: An eating zoom is a crash zoom into a bite, with food or a utensil as the last foreground. Appetite is the punch-in.
Mouth in enters the mouth as landscape. Eating zoom is optical and food-first: the crash ends on the bite.

faq.q: When should I use Eating Zoom?
faq.a: Use it when the bite is the event. Do not use it as coverage of a whole dinner table.

faq.q: How do I prompt Eating Zoom for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write a snap into food meeting mouth. Example: Eating zoom on [Subject], a crash into the bite, chopsticks or spoon as the last foreground.
